product: VYVGART and VYVGART Hytrulo, efgartigimod, the first approved FcRn blocker, approved for gMG including all serotypes in the US and for CIDP, plus ITP in Japan. Pipeline includes empasiprubart anti-C2, adimanebart, ARGX-121 anti-IgA, ARGX-109 anti-IL-6, ARGX-213, ARGX-124, ARGX-118, ARGX-125, TSP-101 and Forte FB102 anti-CD122.
demand: Demand is unmet-need driven in severe autoimmune disease, notably IMNM, which has no approved therapy, and about 100,000 US autoimmune myositis patients of whom roughly 20,000 have IMNM and 40,000 dermatomyositis, with up to 80 percent reporting long-term disability. Q2 2026 product net sales of 1.5 billion dollars, up 60 percent year over year, show the demand is real and volume-led.
pricing_power: Pricing power looks strong in the US as a first-in-class biologic with no direct competitor in myositis, but is constrained by payer management in gMG and CIDP and by public pricing and reimbursement in Europe and Japan. Management disclosed no price increases; growth is patient-volume driven, and cost of sales of 145 million dollars on 1.5 billion dollars of sales implies roughly 90 percent gross margin.
competition: J and J and UCB compete in FcRn gMG and CIDP. IVIG and corticosteroids dominate myositis standard of care. Zai Lab is the China partner. argenx also competes with itself by advancing ARGX-213 and ARGX-124 as next-generation FcRn molecules. FB102 faces vitiligo and celiac rivals. FcRn competitive read is context; the ALKIVIA and Q2 releases are the primary base.
team: Karen Massey is Chief Executive Officer, with founder Tim Van Hauwermeiren as Chairperson of the Board. Luc Truyen, Chief Medical Officer, presented the ALKIVIA results. The Sep 17 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting appointed Thomas M. Brakel and Khurem Farooq as non-executive directors. Headcount is roughly 1,863. No unusual insider selling was found in the sources read; leadership transition detail is partly aggregator context.
market_strategy: Vision 2030: treat 50,000 patients globally, secure 10 labeled indications and advance five pipeline candidates into registrational development by 2030. Levers are FcRn label expansion into myositis, ocular myasthenia gravis, ITP, Sjogren's disease and Graves' disease, a 2027 subcutaneous autoinjector, empasiprubart in MMN and CIDP, and bolt-on deals such as Forte. Commercial model is US-first with Zai Lab for Greater China.
bull: Q2 2026 product sales $1.5B, +60% y/y and +17% q/q, volume-led with ~90% gross margin; ALKIVIA Phase 3 met primary endpoint p=0.0011; US gMG label expanded to all serotypes; 17 raises vs 2 downgrades in 90 days.
bear: ALKIVIA dermatomyositis cohort missed (p=0.1093), so the win rests on ~20k IMNM patients; R&D +47% y/y to $486M outpacing gross profit; Forte bought at $77/share for Phase 1-2 assets; ~32x forward earnings prices perfection.
falsifier: The Q4 2026 EMPASSION MMN readout (empasiprubart) fails its primary endpoint, or the Q3 2026 report on 2026-10-22 shows product sales growth decelerating below 40% y/y.
web_what_changed: Jul 23 2026 H1 and Q2 results: quarterly product net sales 1.5 billion dollars, up 60 percent year over year and 17 percent sequentially; US label expanded to all gMG serotypes. Jul 27 announced and Aug 27 2026 completed acquisition of Forte Biosciences at 77 dollars per share cash, adding anti-CD122 FB102. Aug 17 2026 Phase 3 ALKIVIA myositis trial met primary endpoint, p=0.0011. Sep 17 2026 EGM seated two new non-executive directors.
web_not_known_yesterday: Not found. No ARGX-specific disclosure dated Sep 24 or Sep 25 2026 was located on the SEC filing list, the company newsroom or the wire feed. Most recent dated items are aggregator-only: Sep 23 2026 Barron's report that Morgan Stanley named argenx among moonshot biotech stocks, and Sep 21 2026 Bank of America maintaining Buy with a 1136 dollar target.
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Volume and mix, not price. Management attributes Q2 2026 growth to patient expansion: US launch of the all-serotype gMG label, CIDP uptake and geographic rollout. No list-price increase was disclosed. Sequential growth of 17 percent on top of 60 percent year over year indicates new-patient volume, with mix shifting toward CIDP and the later gMG serotypes. Primary.
web_suppliers: argenx relies on third-party manufacturers, service providers and fill-finish partners, disclosed in its filings as a risk. The one named technology dependency is Halozyme ENHANZE recombinant human hyaluronidase PH20, the delivery component of VYVGART Hytrulo. No supply constraint or shortage was disclosed in the Q2 2026 results or the Forte acquisition release. Primary for disclosure, supplier names otherwise not detailed.
web_customers: End customers are patients, prescribers and payers in the US, EU, Japan and Greater China, served through specialty distribution and infusion networks. No single-customer concentration is disclosed. The real concentration is geographic and partner-based: Zai Lab holds exclusive development and commercialization rights for VYVGART in Greater China. No customer above 10 percent of revenue is named. Primary.
web_who_loses: FcRn and myositis incumbents. J and J with nipocalimab and UCB compete in FcRn-driven gMG and CIDP and lose share as argenx label expansion proceeds. Corticosteroids, broad immunosuppressants and IVIG or plasma-derived therapy lose myositis volume, hitting plasma fractionators. In celiac and vitiligo, FB102 could displace symptomatic standard of care. Competitive attribution is aggregator context, not a filed number.
web_contradicting_evidence: In ALKIVIA the dermatomyositis cohort alone missed significance at p=0.1093; only the combined IMNM plus DM population met the primary endpoint, so the clean statistical win sits in the smaller IMNM group of roughly 20,000 US patients. Q2 2026 R and D expense rose 47 percent year over year to 486 million dollars, outpacing gross profit. Two downgrades in 90 days: Deutsche Bank Aug 24 2026 and Wall Street Zen Sep 19 2026. Forte cost 77 dollars per share cash for Phase 1 and 2 assets.
web_if_management_right: A myositis filing and approval push VYVGART into rheumatology, the EMPASSION MMN readout in Q4 2026 validates empasiprubart as a second pipeline-in-a-product, and the 2027 subcutaneous autoinjector launch broadens delivery. Vision 2030 targets 50,000 treated patients and 10 labeled indications. Analysts model revenue of about 6.3 billion dollars in 2026 and 7.6 billion in 2027; UBS calls VYVGART a potential 20 billion dollar drug.
web_if_management_wrong: The Q4 2026 EMPASSION MMN readout or the myositis regulatory submission breaks first, because both carry the expansion thesis and the premium multiple. If FcRn label expansions stall, growth reverts to gMG and CIDP alone and the roughly 32 times forward earnings multiple compresses. The cost base is the second crack: Q2 2026 R and D grew 47 percent and SG and A 28 percent against a Forte asset still in Phase 1 and 2.
web_second_order_beneficiaries: Halozyme collects ENHANZE royalties on every VYVGART Hytrulo dose. Zai Lab gains Greater China economics with no development cost. Contract manufacturers and fill-finish CDMOs absorb rising volumes. Autoantibody diagnostic labs gain as serotype testing expands across all gMG serotypes and myositis subtypes. Specialty pharmacy and infusion networks also benefit. First two are named in primary disclosures; the rest is inference from the model, not a filed figure.
